message: Hi, could you share the latest tracking update for order 84922?
handling_instruction: Look up the customer's identifier and use only the current verified tracking facts.

message: Order 84920 ka latest update bata do. Mujhe delivery ka wait hai.
handling_instruction: Explain the current verified tracking update in the customer's language; never invent an arrival date.

message: Order 84930 ka size loose hai. Isko return karne ka process batao.
handling_instruction: Explain only supplied return policy; a teammate must check eligibility before any refund or exchange commitment.

message: I accidentally placed order 84921. Can your team check whether cancellation is possible?
handling_instruction: Ask a teammate to check cancellation options; do not claim the order was cancelled.

message: Can you locate order 68417? I cannot find its tracking details.
handling_instruction: An identifier with no matching record needs corrected details; never borrow another order's facts.

message: My package hasn’t arrived. Could someone check its location?
handling_instruction: Ask for the order number or linked phone before making any delivery claim.

message: My receipt shows order 84922, but please check order 84920 instead.
handling_instruction: Ask which order to check when identifiers conflict; do not silently choose one.

message: Order 84924 is marked delivered, but nobody at home received it.
handling_instruction: When a delivered scan is disputed, request a teammate's proof-of-delivery check before preparing a customer reply.
